function.name: read_source
function.description: Read half-open Unicode offsets; omit end for a byte-bounded remaining prefix.

function.name: replace_source
function.description: Propose an exact unique observed replacement; host admission is required.

function.name: find_source
function.description: Search scoped file/symbol/window metadata. Without query, page the outline. Prefer small named units; read_source_unit acquires their exact source. Metadata is not a source witness. offset pages results. A supplied path must be an exact authorized file-resource address, never a directory or prefix. Omit path to search authorized resources under the existing result limits.

function.name: read_source_unit
function.description: Read an exact current unit from find_source. Partial results report the next Unicode offset; use read_source for adjacent ranges. Select enclosing/file IDs from metadata only when needed. Source and request byte limits still apply.
